Felix Whindlebolt is a gnome quest giver located in Whitebeard's Encampment within Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. Trying to rejoin his fellow gnomes, Felix got lost on the way from Anvilmar to Gnomeregan. While traveling, his sole possessions switched hands and now belong to the Frostmane ice trolls. Whindlebolt entices adventurers with soft hearts to help him get his things back and in turn become his "savior".

A Felhound Tracker is summoned by players using a Fel Orb. They are used in order to track down Azsharite for the quest Azsharite (quest). It is speculated that Loramus Thalipedes' felhounds (Raytaf, Shahiar, and Zaman) are tracking hounds too. For more information on how to control the Felhound Tracker, please refer to your Fel Tracker Owner's Manual.

__NOTOC__ The Felskorn Warcamp is a vrykul camp occupied by the Felskorn clan found on a cliffside overlooking the Runewood in Stormheim. The Felpaw clan is a corrupted furbolg group based in Felpaw Village in northern Felwood. They are led by Chieftain Bloodpaw who is protected by many of his shaman and guards. The Felpaws are even more deadly than their Deadwood cousins. The Timbermaws are at war against the corrupted Felpaw and Deadwood clans. The satyrs in Jadefire Run, a satyr camp close to Felpaw Village, are likely the source of the continuing corruption of the Felpaws.
